storyMissionSection.headline:
Our Story
& Our Mission
storyMissionSection.bodyText: Kiddos was born from a simple idea: combine all the good things we’ve seen in youth programs and leave out the not-so-good. Atlanta native Lara Cornett founded Kiddos in 2011, and her approach became “The Kiddos Way”: a fun place to play where kids get to make choices, feel safe and build confidence, guided by energetic role models who truly care about them.

growthSection.headline: Our Growth
growthSection.bodyText: What began as a summer day camp grew into year-round programs. Today Kiddos runs after school programs at three Atlanta schools (E. Rivers, Atlanta Classical Academy and Garden Hills), along with our summer Day Camp and the year-round Kiddos Early Learning Center. Keeping The Kiddos Way alive takes an amazing team that feels more like family, or “framily,” as we say.

teamSection.headline: Our Team
teamSection.bodyText: All team members undergo background checks and rigorous training. We train our teachers to prioritize safety and to be engaging role models who bring creativity, enthusiasm and empathy. Some of our staff literally grew up with Kiddos: a camper from 2011 is now a director.

recognitionSection.headline:
Recognition
& Community Trust
recognitionSection.bodyText:
Kiddos has been recognized in the community for excellence. Our after school programs have earned a “Best Afterschool Program” title in a local poll, and our camp was voted “Best Summer Camp in Atlanta” in Red Tricycle’s Totally Awesome Awards. These awards mean a lot to us because they come from the families we serve.

heroSection.subHeadline: Registration for School Year 26/27 is online. You will be required to accept and follow all our policies before completing registration. Follow the steps below to get started:

steps.title: 1. Review the Policies:
steps.description: Review all Kiddos policies and procedures for your school: E. Rivers, Garden Hills or Atlanta Classical. The highlights are on our Parent & Guardian Info page.

steps.title: 2. Setup Your Account:
steps.description: Click the “Enroll” button below (or on our menu) to go to our online registration portal, then log in or create a new account.

steps.title: 3. Register Each Child
steps.description: Register each child for Full Time or Drop In, answer all questions thoroughly and update any new information. Students may start only on Mondays, when space is available. Same-day registration is not allowed.

steps.title: 4. Confirmation Email

policiesPage.pageDescription:
To keep After School smooth and enjoyable for everyone, please take note of our key policies.

You will be required to accept and follow all our policies before completing registration. Here are the highlights.

policies.headline:
Student
Conduct
policies.bodyText: Our staff use positive reinforcement. If unsafe or inappropriate behavior continues after three written notices, the student has a one week probation, and continued problems lead to dismissal. Kiddos may dismiss a student immediately if others or staff are at risk. Conflicts are handled through redirection, peer resolution, discussion, removal of privileges and parent meetings.

policies.headline:
Homework
& Smart Club
policies.bodyText: Students get a maximum of one hour of homework time per day during SMART CLUB, with a 1 to 15 ratio, and finish any remaining work at home. Staff cannot help with long term projects or book reports and do not guarantee accuracy, so parents remain responsible for checking homework. There is no homework time during special events and rehearsals (about 4 days per year).

policies.headline:
Electronics
Policy
policies.bodyText: Electronics and toys are not allowed, and Kiddos is not responsible for any items brought in. Parents, please stay off your cell phone when picking up your child.

policies.headline:
Communication
& Absences
policies.bodyText: Text or call your school’s Kiddos director as soon as possible if your student will be absent. After two absences without notice, $10 is charged to the account. We email quarterly updates, emergencies and invoices, and ask you to keep phone numbers, addresses, emergency contacts and pick-up lists up to date.

policies.headline:
Pick-Up
& Late Pick-Up
policies.bodyText:
An authorized adult must report to the cafeteria to sign out their child and keep the child with them until they leave the building. Students must be picked up by 6:30pm. Late fees start at $5 plus $1 per minute and increase with each occurrence; a ninth late pick-up ends eligibility.

[CONFIRM: Atlanta Classical is open until 6:00pm, but its policy page gives a 6:30 pick-up deadline.]

policies.headline:
Medical Needs
& Illness
policies.bodyText: Kiddos will not give medication without a completed medical form. Parents must provide inhalers or EpiPens for known conditions. Children with a contagious illness or a fever may not attend, and sick children must be picked up promptly. Enrolled children must have health insurance.

policies.headline:
Snacks
& Allergies
policies.bodyText: Registered students who are signed in receive snacks and lemonade. Please report allergies, their severity and any required supplies or steps. You may pack extra snacks.

policies.headline:
Weather
& Closures
policies.bodyText: Kiddos is closed on school break days and holidays, and closes when school is closed for weather or dismisses early. No reimbursement is given for those days.

policies.headline:
Photos
& Social Media
policies.bodyText: By registering, parents grant Kiddos and its partners the right to use their child’s image, name and statements in advertising and promotions.

heroSection.description: Kiddos takes the guesswork out of after school. From homework help to pick-up, we’ve got you covered with answers that are clear, caring, and full of peace of mind.

faqPage.note: [The after school site has no FAQ. These 15 questions mirror the camp FAQ; every answer is taken from the after school pages and policies. Please review.]

faqs.question: Q: What grades does Kiddos After School serve?
faqs.answer: Pre-K through 5th grade at E. Rivers and Kindergarten through 6th grade at Atlanta Classical Academy. [GARDEN HILLS GRADES NEEDED]

faqs.question: Q: What are the After School hours?
faqs.answer: 2:15–6:30pm at E. Rivers and Garden Hills, and until 6:00pm at Atlanta Classical, every day school is open. We are closed on school break days, holidays and inclement weather days.

faqs.question: Q: Where is After School located? Do you provide transportation?
faqs.answer: Onsite at each school: E. Rivers, Garden Hills Elementary and Atlanta Classical Academy. Kiddos does not provide transportation; students come to the cafeteria when the bell rings.

faqs.question: Q: What does a typical afternoon look like?
faqs.answer: Each day is broken into Snack Time, Outside Time, Homework Help and Activity Choices. We also offer After School Specials, Fun Fridays and a Showcase each semester.

faqs.question: Q: Will my child get homework help?
faqs.answer: Yes. Smart Club is an hour each day for homework, studying or reading. Teachers are on hand to answer questions and review. We cannot guarantee accuracy or help with long term projects, so parents remain responsible for checking homework.

faqs.question: Q: Do you offer Drop-Ins or Part Time?
faqs.answer: Garden Hills and Atlanta Classical offer Full Time or daily Drop-In. E. Rivers is Full Time enrollment only. Drop-in students must be registered before their first day and confirm each day by text, email or call.

faqs.question: Q: What is the staff-to-student ratio? Who are the teachers?
faqs.answer: Ratios are 1 to 15, and 1 to 9 for Pre-K. Our After School teachers are energetic, trained and love their job.

faqs.question: Q: How much does After School cost?
faqs.answer: There is a $50 annual registration fee per child. Full Time for a first child is $470/month at E. Rivers and $425/month at Garden Hills and Atlanta Classical. Drop-Ins are $28 per day. See Rates & Enrollment for every rate.

faqs.question: Q: How and when am I billed?
faqs.answer: Online only, by Visa, MasterCard or Discover. Full Time tuition is auto charged to the card on file each month. Drop-Ins are totaled monthly and auto charged on the 10th of the following month. A declined card or late payment incurs a $25 fee. No cash or check.

faqs.question: Q: Do you offer any discounts or financial assistance?
faqs.answer: Yes. Second and third children pay reduced rates, and we offer sliding scale scholarships, first come first served, based on income and other extenuating circumstances. Scholarships for SY 26/27 are now closed.

faqs.question: Q: What is your cancellation policy?
faqs.answer: Email two weeks’ notice to cancel Full Time care. Your final balance is the instructional days enrolled multiplied by the daily rate, minus tuition paid. Switching between Drop-In and Full Time costs $25; the first change is free.

faqs.question: Q: What happens if I am late for pick-up?
faqs.answer: Late fees are auto charged to the card on file: $5 plus $1 per minute for the first two occurrences, $15 plus $1 per minute for occurrences 3–5, and $30 plus $1 per minute for occurrences 6–8. After a ninth late pick-up the student is no longer eligible to attend.

faqs.question: Q: What is your behavior policy?
faqs.answer: Staff use positive reinforcement. If unsafe or inappropriate behavior continues after three written notices, the student has a one week probation, and continued problems lead to dismissal.

faqs.question: Q: What are Extracurricular Classes? Does my child have to be in After School?
faqs.answer: Classes such as Chess, Martial Arts, Gymnastics, Film Making, STEM, Soccer and Tap/Ballet, each owned and operated by an individual company, with registration handled by Kiddos. You do not have to be in After School to participate. See Extracurricular Classes.

faqs.question: Q: I have more questions. How do I contact you?
faqs.answer: Email Info@KiddosAtlanta.com, call or text 404.955.3184, or reach your school’s director directly: E. Rivers 404.821.8210, Garden Hills 404.922.8156, Atlanta Classical 404.821.8113. You can also use our Contact Us page.
